story.short_description: Moros, The Eclipse Wraith. The silent executioner of the RedVerse.
story.long_description: When the Fracture ripped open the cosmos, the resulting entropy and death coalesced into a single entity. Moros resides in the Eclipsed Necropolis, a dark realm where the souls of shattered realities gather. He is the ultimate executioner, wielding the Eclipse Scythe to reap the dimensional energy of those who disturb the final rest of the universe.
story.origin: Manifested from the collective entropy of the Fracture
story.purpose: To serve as the necessary force of death and execution.
story.legacy: The grim reaper of the RedVerse.

combat.combat_style: Silent, lethal, sweeping executions. He uses the scythe to reap the dimensional energy of his foes, leaving nothing behind.

personality.strength: Lethal precision and the ability to sever souls from physical forms.
personality.weakness: Can be overwhelmed by pure, blinding radiant light.

art_direction.silhouette: Tall, slender, grim reaper-esque, spiked and tattered.
art_direction.pose: Standing ominously, holding the scythe like a reaper.
art_direction.camera: Epic, dramatic framing against the eclipsed moon.
art_direction.environment: A dark, gothic nightmare realm with floating black spires, massive iron chains, and a dark eclipsed moon in the stormy purple sky.
art_direction.lighting: Dark atmospheric lighting punctuated by intense, glowing violet energy and moonlight.
art_direction.materials: Sleek, jagged vantablack plate armor, heavily tattered dark cloth.
art_direction.visual_theme: Grim Reaper, Gothic Horror, Violet Eclipse.
art_direction.art_direction_notes: The purple singularity core and scythe edge must emit a soft but intense violet glow that illuminates the dark armor.

lore.origin: Formed from the collective death of countless universes during the Fracture.
lore.history: Moros does not speak. He simply appears where death is required on a cosmic scale.
lore.purpose: To reap the dimensional energy of those whose time has ended.
lore.legend: When the sky turns purple and the moon eclipses, the Wraith has come to collect.
lore.current_mission: Harvesting the corrupted souls of the Void.
lore.secrets: He is the only Guardian who can permanently kill another Guardian.
quotes: "..." (He never speaks. The sound of his scythe dragging is his only warning.)
famous_battles: The Reaping of the Undying City
lore.architect_notes: We created life. He is what happens when life expires.

rivals: Aurelius (Aurelius creates order; Moros represents the inevitable end of that order)
